topic: Physical and linear fixed-set descriptions of destruction-covariant channels
title: Fixed points of superchannels for dephasing-covariant channels

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending the two-sided destruction construction of Saxena, Chitambar and Gour (2019), we answer Yoeli and Gour's fixed-superchannel question in Instability as a Quantum Resource, arXiv:2602.18323v1, p. 5, Open directions, negatively: in every dimension d >= 3, dephasing-covariant channels are not exactly the fixed channels of any deterministic superchannel. Any completely positive Choi action fixing every such channel must be the identity. Two-sector pinching, including qubit complete dephasing, admits an explicit physical projection. Uniformity-preserving channels have the same obstruction in every dimension d >= 2. Explicit negative determinants distinguish linear projection from physical retraction and give a counterexample to the affine-set assertion in arXiv:2402.05474v2, Theorem 9.2.
summary: Complete dephasing: positive for d = 1, 2, negative for d >= 3. Uniformity preservation: negative for d >= 2. Two-sector pinching: positive in every dimension.

posing_source.coverage: Answered: no in general; positive and negative special cases are distinguished.
